title: stk handover key --json
description: What `stk handover key --json` prints on stdout: this broker's public hand-over key, which can only seal. Written from supertoolkit internal/setup/headless.go (`map[string]string{"public_key": …}`). AgentPod's node-agent reads `public_key` and refuses an empty one (apps/node-agent/internal/stkclient/stkclient.go, HandoverKey). On failure stk exits non-zero and writes `stk: <message>` to stderr; that text and the exit code are not part of this contract (phase 4, ruling 4).

public_key.description: The hand-over key, `stk-handover-v1:` and the X25519 public key in unpadded base64url (fixtures/supertoolkit/handover-v1.json).
